label: early-to-mid original-phase input of v/e/o/x/3/j/c/z/t
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase at positions t=2..7, peaking at t=3-4. 99.9% of activation mass is in the original phase. It never fires at t=0-1 or in the copy phase, and fires only weakly on <DEL>. Position alone covers 98% of mass but has precision 0.16. The input token gates it: v is by far the strongest (rate 0.28, 27% of mass, includes all top activations), followed by e, o, x, 3, j, c, z, t. First occurrences of a token make up 89% of mass. Magnitude also rises when the sequence starts with 0, y or b. Requiring first_tok in that group raises precision to 0.68 but halves recall. The position-plus-token predicate leaves out a context-dependent (graded) remainder, so precision stays near 0.42.
